observations: Black Sony PlayStation 4 console, original 'Fat' design with a split glossy/matte top.
One North American (Type A) power cable.
Visible scuffs and scratches on the glossy section of the console in photo 1.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI AHMAD SHONEKAN' is visible on both photos.
The console is placed on artificial grass.

The North American power plug in photo 0 is consistent with Canadian origin but does not prove it.
Photo 1 shows significant scuffing on the glossy top plate.

risks.proof: Video of the controller being used to navigate menus or in a game.
Photo of the 'System Information' screen in settings.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the dashboard.
Video of a game disc being loaded and played.
Photo of the System Information screen showing storage and software version.

response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a first-generation PS4. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-working/parts) until functionality is proven.
